caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The jug is rendered in shades of pale grayish tan, with darker areas indicating shadows and curves. Its upper rim appears uneven and is shaded with brown and reddish tones, suggesting an earthenware material. On the front surface of the jug, there is a decorative blue floral motif featuring several stylized leaves and circular flower-like shapes. Above the decoration, there is blue text that appears to read "M. CLARK & CO. ROCHESTER NY," which is centered on the upper half of the jug. At the bottom left corner of the image, the name "Jessie M. Youngs" is handwritten in small, neat script. No other objects or decorations are present in the composition.
title: Water Pitcher
